summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 62 (Unified Node Codec - Core Keystone) of the CipherBox project using the GSD workflow, replacing legacy FolderMetadata/FileMetadata types with a unified Node type featuring dual-sealed bodies, generation-as-AAD, vault v3 hard-cut, and frozen golden vectors.
summary.outcome: Phase 62 fully planned (9 plans / 7 waves, verification passed 15/15 dimensions) and executed end-to-end with 190/190 core tests green, all three consumer packages (sdk-core, sdk, web) typechecking clean, and the phase marked complete with VERIFICATION.md confirming all 6 success criteria.

repo: The dependency chain for typechecking is strictly ordered: core dist/ must rebuild before sdk-core, sdk-core before sdk, sdk before web — each consumer typechecks against the upstream built dist/

file-ipns.test.ts imported from ../file/derive-ipns and ../file/metadata (retired modules), not from the live ipns/ module (create-record.ts, sign-record.ts); it was correctly deleted rather than quarantined
apps/web has no tsconfig.build.json — tsc -b (project references) is the correct typecheck invocation, not tsc -p tsconfig.build.json

tsconfig.scripts.json TS2688 'Cannot find type definition file for node' is a pre-existing local-install artifact: @types/node is declared in root package.json as ^22.19.7 but missing from local node_modules; resolves on CI with fresh pnpm install
apps/web/public/recovery.html still contains v2 blob logic — out of scope for Phase 62, zero production impact as it is not imported anywhere
packages/sdk upload-batch.test.ts has stale-mock type drift but passes at runtime (20/20 tests) and is excluded from the production build typecheck path
Core test count drop 228→190 after Wave 3 cutover accounts for folder-metadata.test.ts (17 tests) + file-ipns.test.ts (21 tests), both legitimately retired with the deleted modules
Retired type names (FolderMetadata, FilePointer, etc.) appearing in grep hits post-cutover are all migration comments in live files, not live imports — confirmed by tsc clean
The schema-gate hook scans for ORM files (Prisma/Drizzle/TypeORM/Payload/Supabase); packages/core registry/schema.ts and bin/types.ts are not ORM schemas and correctly skip the gate
gsd-tools query commit can return commit_failed as a false-negative even when the commit lands cleanly (lint-staged passes, git log confirms the hash)

code.finding: New file created in Wave 1 (plan 62-01): defines Node, SealedChildRef, PublishedNode, content/write-body types replacing legacy FolderMetadata/FileMetadata
New file created in Wave 2 (plan 62-02): sealNode/unsealNode composing Phase-61 sealAesGcmAad/buildNodeAad primitives; wire format frozen via tests/vectors/node-codec.json
Cross-language golden vector committed in Wave 1 (plan 62-03); must live in tests/vectors/ (not inline in test files) to enable Phase-69 Rust cross-language parity testing
Frozen in Wave 2 (plan 62-02) with fixed-key/fixed-IV full-seal lock reusing Phase-61 node_id/IV; reserved slot for Phase-69 Rust test
Wave 3 (plan 62-05) cutover: dropped folder/ and file/ exports, added node/ barrel export; folder/ and file/ directories deleted (7 files total)
Anti-drift update added a current-state note that the keystone codec landed; milestone requirements not moved to Validated (Milestone 4 is mid-flight, phases 62-69)

workflow: gsd plan-phase step 13d commits PLAN/STATE/ROADMAP but not PATTERNS.md — PATTERNS.md must be committed explicitly after the pattern-mapper subagent returns (known workflow gap)
API surface intel returning 0 symbols (HINT-only file) should be omitted from the planner prompt rather than injected as empty context

Sequential execution on the main tree is preferred over parallel worktrees in pnpm monorepos because worktrees lack node_modules and require per-worktree pnpm install, which is slow and risks cross-package dist chain complexity

workflow.auto_advance=true in config would chain straight into execute-phase after planning; for keystone phases with broad blast radius, deliberately suppressing auto-advance and requiring explicit user intent is safer

Plan-checker revision caught five issues in one pass: RESEARCH.md needing (RESOLVED) markers (required gate), cross-language vector placement (tests/vectors/ not inline), exit-code-safe tsc verify patterns, grep-based web test quarantine discovery, and plan size split (>threshold → 08a/08b)
The Nyquist validation gate requires RESEARCH.md to have a ## Validation Architecture section; when present, VALIDATION.md must be created from the template before the planner runs
gsd-tools query commit false-negatives are a known pattern — always verify landing with git log rather than retrying the commit
--no-transition flag in execute-phase stops at PHASE COMPLETE rather than auto-chaining to Phase 63; essential for unsupervised execution of keystone phases

friction: gsd-tools query commit returned commit_failed for VALIDATION.md commit but the commit landed (2475ae35d) — false-negative caused unnecessary concern and a git log verification detour
Node eval for worktree-mode resolution had a quoting/escaping bug, requiring a manual re-extraction and explicit decision
Drift pre-check flagged 143 pre-existing elements (stale baseline map) with action_required:warn — purely noise with no actionable signal for Phase 62
apps/web has no tsconfig.build.json, causing tsc -p tsconfig.build.json to fail with TS5058 during the D-02 gate check — required diagnosing that tsc -b is the correct invocation
Pre-existing TS2688 in tsconfig.scripts.json surfaced during root pnpm typecheck and required multi-step diagnosis (git diff, @types/node check) to confirm it predated Phase 62
Pattern mapper agent-skills block was empty, requiring a fetch round-trip that returned no usable content
Requirements coverage display had a word-splitting glitch (all six IDs printed as one token), requiring a clean re-run to record an accurate result
open_items: apps/web/public/recovery.html still contains v2 vault blob logic — needs update in a future web-layer phase
packages/sdk upload-batch.test.ts stale-mock type drift: passes at runtime but type-incorrect mocks will silently mask future type changes
Local @types/node is missing from node_modules (stale install); root pnpm typecheck step fails locally but passes on CI — run pnpm install to fix, deferred to avoid lockfile drift
Codebase baseline map is stale (drift pre-check flagged 143 elements); /gsd-map-codebase should be run to reset the baseline
Phase 65 owns write-chain/share/bin/invite behavioral implementations currently stubbed with 'not implemented — phase 65' throws across sdk-core and sdk
Phase 69 owns Rust cross-language integration tests; frozen node-codec.json and vault-v3-blob.json vectors are reserved with Phase-61 node_id/IV for that purpose
Phase 63 is the next phase (STATE.md advanced); execution of Phases 63-69 completes Milestone 4 (v2.0)
